A new library for compute volume using lithops and a new kind of Dicom Files stored in cloud

KuroCloudDicom KuroCloudDicom computes volumes over DICOM image collections stored in S3-compatible object storage, running the work in parallel with Lithops. It works in two steps: 1. **Preprocess and upload.** Each DICOM image is decoded, split into chunks and uploaded as a compressed "CloudDicom" object, together with a `metadata.json` describing the collection. 2. **Compute the volume.** The chunk keys are distributed across Lithops workers, each worker sums the physical area of its chunks, and the results are reduced and multiplied by the slice thickness. The computed volume is the full image extent of every slice (`Σ rows · cols · pixel_spacing[0] · pixel_spacing[1] · slice_thickness`), in the units of the DICOM spacing attributes (normally mm³). No segmentation is performed. Installation ```bash pip install KuroCloudDicom ``` Pytho
